name: the-real-unifi-mcp
description: MCP server for UniFi Site Manager + Network APIs (documented endpoints, read + write, cloud-only).

unifi_api_key.title: Site Manager API Key
unifi_api_key.description: Site Manager API key with Network scope.

confirm_writes.title: Confirm destructive writes
confirm_writes.description: If checked, write and delete tools return a preview and only execute when called again with confirm: "YES".

read_only.title: Read-only mode
read_only.description: If checked, write and delete tools return an error and send no request; read tools still work.

redact_secrets.title: Hide secrets in results
redact_secrets.description: If checked, passwords, WiFi passphrases, pre-shared keys and other secret fields in tool results are replaced by (redacted). Write tools refuse a body that contains that placeholder.
